seo_description: Samuel Bahago Gabriel is a GIS Analyst using spatial analysis, remote sensing and hydrology to support environmental and infrastructure decisions in Nigeria.

hero.lead: I turn satellite imagery, maps and field evidence into practical insights for flood resilience, water resources and environmental planning.
hero.summary: My work spans strategic catchment planning, flood resilience, dam and irrigation studies, land-cover analysis and environmental assessment across Nigeria.

work.heading: Earth science informs the analysis. Clear communication makes it useful.
paragraphs: I combine satellite imagery, terrain models, field evidence and stakeholder knowledge to build defensible spatial products.
My goal is not simply to produce maps, but to explain patterns, support planning and make technical evidence accessible.

contact.heading: Have a spatial problem worth solving?
contact.intro: I am open to GIS, remote-sensing, water-resources and environmental-planning opportunities.
